turns.text: A component re-renders when its state changes via setState or a useState setter, or when its parent re-renders, which by default re-renders all children even if props didn't change. It also re-renders when a context it consumes via useContext gets a new value. Props changing is really just a side effect of the parent re-rendering. You can skip unnecessary renders with React.memo, useMemo/useCallback for stable references, or by moving state down closer to where it's used. Also worth noting: in StrictMode during dev, components render twice to help catch side effects.

Thanks, Sana.

**Question 2:** Explain the event loop in one minute.
